title: Nonparametric In-Context Learning and Inference via Measure-Indexed Kernel Ridge Regression
summary: In-Context learning enables an estimator, trained across multiple tasks, to adapt to a new unseen task solely through its in-context samples, without any parameter refitting. Despite growing interest in the statistical foundations of in-context learning, two gaps still remain. First, existing convergence results do not characterize the distributional behavior of the in-context learning estimators.
